testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore Tutorials from Show Panels: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:681:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore Tutorials from Show Panels ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Tutorials panel is visible after Team Web ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the Tools tab context menu ✔ Then Tutorials is checked ✔ When the user selects Tutorials ✔ Then the Tutorials panel disappears from the Tools ribbon ✔ And the other visible Tools panels remain available ✔ When the user reopens Show Panels ✔ Then Tutorials is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Tutorials ✔ Then the Tutorials panel reappears after Team Web ✔ And Show Panels marks Tutorials as visible
